description: FastAPI router module for managing submission-related endpoints in a data submission and approval workflow. It includes routes for creating, retrieving, validating, and approving/rejecting submissions, with detailed role-based authorization and error handling.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object configured for submissions API endpoints

methods.name: CreateSubmissionResponse create_submission( request: CreateSubmissionRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security) )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new submission from a draft, performs authorization, and queues validation.

methods.name: GetSubmissionResponse get_submission( submission_id: str, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security) )
methods.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific submission by ID, including validation status.

methods.name: TriggerValidationResponse trigger_validation( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security) )
methods.description: Initiate validation process for a specific submission, generating validation run and status.

methods.name: ApproveSubmissionResponse approve_submission( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security) )
methods.description: Approve or reject a submission with electronic signature, enforcing SoD, validation, and state checks.
